import datetime
from icalendar import Calendar, Event
from dateutil import tz

# Read existing calendar
with open("uploads/calendar.ics", "r") as f:

cal = Calendar.from_ical(cal_text)

# Determine this Thursday
today = datetime.date.today()
days_until_thursday = (3 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_until_thursday == 0 and today.weekday() != 3:
    days_until_thursday = 7
this_thursday = today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_until_thursday)

# Create the new event
event = Event()
event.add("summary", "HR-IT Onboarding Coordination Meeting")
event.add("dtstart", datetime.datetime(this_thursday.year, this_thursday.month, this_thursday.day, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=tz.gettz("America/New_York")))
event.add("dtend", datetime.datetime(this_thursday.year, this_thursday.month, this_thursday.day, 10, 30, 0, tzinfo=tz.gettz("America/New_York")))
event.add("location", "Virtual")
event.add("description", "Virtual HR-IT Onboarding Coordination Meeting")
import uuid
event.add("uid", str(uuid.uuid4()))
event.add("dtstamp", datetime.datetime.now(tz=tz.UTC))

# Add event to calendar
cal.add_component(event)

# Write updated calendar
with open("uploads/calendar.ics", "wb") as f:
    f.write(cal.to_ical())

'''
